This can only be used in conjunction the the Gold Saucer Randomizer available from: https://github.com/blazerwazey/Gold-Saucer/releases

V0.0.2.description:
Define _GOLD_CHOCOBO_EARLY_REGIONS set (Kalm, Mythril Mines, Chocobo Farm, Fort Condor, Junon, Corel, Gold Saucer Area, Midgar Sector 5)
Add item_rule in _apply_free_roam_rules to block Gold Chocobo placement in early-reachable regions
Remove Gold Chocobo from early_priority_items list in create_regions (keep Green Chocobo, Submarine, Highwind)
V0.0.2.title: V0.0.2 FF7 APWorld

v0.0.3.description:
Patch Notes:

FF7: Free Roam game-over recovery - auto re-deliver all received items after a Game Over, fix key-item gate-flag conflicts, PHS menu lock, and armor init

Add automatic game-over detection and item re-delivery: latch module 26 (Game Over), debounce _RESUME_REDELIVER_TICKS stable gameplay ticks, then re-queue all received items to restore key items/vehicles/party/chocobos/inventory wiped by md1stin baseline reload

Add /resync command for manual re-delivery (same mechanism as auto recovery)
v0.0.3.title: V0.0.3 FF7 APWorld

v0.0.4.description:
**New**
- **AP shop descriptions show classification** — `An Archipelago Item for <Player> - <Progression/Useful/Filler/Trap> Item`.
- **`disable_fort_condor_checks`** YAML option (World group). This only effects the minigame checks.

**Locations**
- **Red Submarine** is a working check — ram detection uses the game's natural flag (`0x0EF6.0`); the materia hits your menu only when received via AP.
- **Cosmo Canyon Item Store** double pickup (Elixir + Magic Source) added.
- **Basement Key** re‑introduced as a check.
- **Glacier Map / Snowboard / Basement Key** locations no longer removed when received via AP.
- **Excluded:** Nibelheim Item Store – Elixir, North Corel – Catastrophe.

**Items / placement**
- **Weapon delivery fixes** — Heaven's Cloud no longer gives Apocalypse; 3 Morph‑phones corrected; 5 duplicate entries removed.
- **Huge Materia** delivered only via AP (in‑game pickups fire the check without adding to the menu).
- **early_priority_items** no longer forces Highwind/Submarine/Green Chocobo early.

**Client / live game**
- **Submarine** spawns *and* is drivable out to sea at Junon.
- **Icicle Inn snowboard cat** moved aside so the pickup is reachable.
- **Limit Breaks** work on AP‑delivered characters (no battle softlock).
- **Game‑over redundancy** — all AP items re‑delivered after a Free Roam game over + `/resync` command.
- **PHS menu** locked until 3 characters received.
- **XP / Gil / Materia(AP) multipliers** apply consistently (incl. after a process restart).
- Reverted the Yuffie forest encounter flag; removed the unused `Var[3][189]` write.
v0.0.4.title: V0.0.4 FF7 APWorld

v0.0.5.description:
New and Changes

Traplink / DeathLink implemented. Most Traps and Deathlinks will only fire while you are in a battle.

Chocobo Race Checks now included, Adds a check for each Chocobo Race Tier

Town Gating Implemented, Find the Keys to enter towns and Dungeons. ( For generations sake, Kalm, Mythril Caves and Fort Condor are not locked behind keys and are open from the start)

/resync has been tightened, No more duplicates of items you've received and no more unintentional vehicle moves.

Shophook and Shop Randomization has been overhauled. Purchased AP Items no longer appear in the store after buying them.

many, MANY, Bug fixes and Logic adjustments. Too many to put in a patch note. 


New Commands:
/keys, Use when town gating is on to show what Towns you have access to 

/highwind and /chocobo, Just incase of a softlock and you vehicle moves across the world map. These will move your vehicle back to you.

/gomode, Shows you in the client what you have and what you are missing from landing in the northern crater.
v0.0.5.title: V0.0.5 FF7 APWorld

v0.0.6.description:
FF7 AP World V0.0.6

APWorld Changes:

Progressive Limits (progressive_limits, default on). Five copies per character teach 1-2, 2-1, 2-2, 3-1, 3-2; level 4 keeps its manual item. The client also stops the game teaching limits off kill and use counts.

Characters item group, so !hint Characters aims at the roster and returns the lowest-sphere member.

The Temple of the Ancients is a real dungeon in Free Roam — 16 checks across kuro_1/2/3/5/6/7/82, gated on ocean traversal and the Keystone, which is enforced in game rather than only in logic.

Endgame areas want a real squad. All three Weapons, the sunken Gelnika, Northern Crater and the Underwater Reactor each need three characters on top of their traversal rule — This is soft logic so a solo Cloud can still access these areas should you wish to.

Scalable AP shop slots (shop_slots_per_shop, default 0). 0 keeps the hand-authored 1-6 per shop; 1-10 overrides uniformly.
Progressive Chocobos (progressive_chocobos, off by default). Four copies of one item grant Yellow → Green → Black → Gold in order.

Characters join at the party leader's level (party_level_sync, on by default). Filed as a feature, but really a bug: the record clone left new members at whatever level the template carried.

Two new YAML opt-outs for check categories, (disable_gil_dump_checks disables the Villa Purchase and Wall Market Weapons store Purchase checks. disable_bone_village_digs disables the bone village dig checks.

Hero Drink is useful, not filler.

Northern Crater Change , The Northern Crater entry has been changed to just requiring the 4 Huge Materia + Highwind. There is now a block at the end of the Northern Crater preventing you from going down the steps to Sephiroth unless you have the 6 required Characters (Tifa, Barret, Red XIII, Cid, Cait Sith, Aerith)

Universal Tracker map publishing The client publishes the current field to data storage for those working with UT and Visual Mapper.

Fort Condor Loss Reset The client will now auto reset the Fort Condor progress if you lose the boss fight once you hit the world map again allowing you to reattempt the final stage minigame and boss fight.

Known Issues:
Minor text display issues in Temple of Ancients
v0.0.6.title: v0.0.6 FF7 APworld
